verdict.rationale: Atlassian's own integrations page documents syncing Trello with Jira Software, which could bring work from a second project management tool into Jira. Nothing shows a unified view filtered to an engineer's assigned tasks across tools, and the 3,000+ Marketplace apps are third-party add-ons, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented aggregated 'my assigned work' view spanning multiple external PM tools, support for PM tools beyond Trello, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Collaborate across tools with transparency and create workflows that work for you by syncing Trello and Jira Software.
